scope: P1 source_files observational watch snapshot only; no authority input, package input, target or write-scope changes
invariants: Only reviewInputs source_files loop may use separate reviewSourceFile. Existing reviewFile remains unchanged for authority/policy binding source/index/package/target checks.
Leaf parent must be canonical: realpath(dirname(absolute)) equals dirname(absolute); absolute lexical path remains within canonical root. Parent symlinks refuse.
Regular files retain unchanged strict reviewFile behavior. Unknown non-file objects refuse.
Symlink leaf read uses readlink bytes only, never target resolution/open/read; return only present:true, kind:symlink, SHA256 link bytes.
Pre/post bigint lstat both show symlink and exactly match dev, ino, birthtimeNs, ctimeNs, mtimeNs, size and mode.
Preview/apply compares complete snapshot, so link replacement, target text change or regular/link kind change refuses.
required_counterexamples: Opaque source leaf symlink to outside or nonexistent target: observation permitted, target not opened, raw target not emitted.
Changing outside target contents alone does not confer authority or change observed link-byte digest.
Changing link bytes after preview refuses apply.
Regular-to-link replacement after preview refuses apply.
Source link nested through a symlink parent refuses.
Authority pin, local policy, bound adopter policy source, installed package files, target and parent symlinks retain previous refusal behavior.
qualification: Interface/source inspection only; implementation and installed positive/refusal evidence remain required.
